rows.gloss: by the rule stated beginning with Parātriṃśikā
intolerant of fixed designations like Śiva-Śakti etc.
preceded by manifesting the stages of will-lords
and by mere reddening of measurable-appearance
by capacity to birth other seeds
as the four seeds called neuter
having form of accepting creative power
by stated union of these two seeds
of this nature, thus the meaning
from pervasion by will-knowledge with full action-power dominant
having form of one-knowing of world up to this
whose self is the two-drop emission inner-outer at once
as said by our lord Utpaladeva
which is the principle of mātṛkā
whose power is indicated by scripture, thus
consisting of entering dense consciousness-bliss own-nature
as if resting in own self
by capacity to birth other seeds
of śa-ṣa-sa, Īśvara... thus of unsurpassed-ha
and of her of this kind
of ka-group ha-emissions from akāra itself
by embracing all universe as one knower
fivefold from ka-beginning to sa-ending emission
